summary_en: ¥37/share annual dividend (¥2 increase from prior forecast of ¥35/share; ¥12 increase vs. FY8/25 actual ¥25/share). DOE 3% applied to revised earnings forecast (net profit ¥730M, up ¥60M). Final dividend ¥37/share. Second quarter dividend ¥0.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast for FY8/26 and Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
UPR Corporation revised its full-year consolidated earnings forecast for FY8/26 (September 2025–August 2026) on 15 July 2026, with revised dividend guidance. Operating profit is now estimated at ¥790M (¥30M higher than prior forecast), ordinary profit at ¥1,150M (¥105M higher), and net income attributable to shareholders at ¥730M (¥60M higher). Sales remain flat at ¥15,600M owing to lower sales volumes stemming from elevated logistics-material costs driven by Middle East geopolitical conditions, offsetting strong progress in pallet-equipment rental, particularly from integrated palletization. The company also factors in restructuring costs from divestiture of the assist-suit and vehicle-solutions businesses and depot consolidation.

On dividend policy, the company maintains its basic principle of targeting DOE (dividend payout ratio on equity) at 3% near-term and 5% long-term, while preserving working capital and internal reserves. The final dividend for FY8/26 is set at ¥37 per share, an increase of ¥2 from the prior forecast of ¥35/share and ¥12 higher than FY8/25's actual ¥25/share. The second quarter dividend is ¥0. The increase reflects the upward earnings revision applied to the DOE 3% policy.
